{{Quote|I won't deny that Kelrodo-Ai is proving a difficult target, but let's remember this: The Western Reaches Operation has restored security and the rule of law to eight sectors so far, with the successful liberation of 95 worlds.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]], during the [[Western Reaches Operation]]|<ref name="TGoKA">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref>}}
The '''Western Reaches''' were an area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] west of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] beyond the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />

Growing because of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], it included overflow from the [[Southern Core]] and the Trailing Sectors as those regions expanded. The legacy of its settlers resulted to a cosmopolitan and diverse population, and the distance from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] caused the area to develop a sense of independence from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. The boldest of them continued exploration westwards to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Western Reaches were the site of a major Imperial [[Western Reaches Operation|campaign]] against [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Its independent spirit made it a place for brooding rebellion during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] along with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] atrocities and secret experiments.<ref name="TEA" />
